detail.title: Criteria for Autonomous Problem Discovery
detail.summary: Autonomous problem discovery can be formalized through value-system learning and multi-objective decision frameworks that capture goal formulation beyond fixed metrics.
detail.reason: Synthesizing literature on value learning and evaluation stress testing to establish foundational criteria for autonomous problem identification.
